Run a hook after retry() sleeps

Source: R/retry_after.R
after_sleep.Rd

  • after_sleep_none() does nothing.

  • after_sleep_log() passes a message describing the attempt to logger.

Usage

after_sleep_none()

after_sleep_log(logger = message)

Arguments

logger

Function taking a single message string. Defaults to message().

Value

A hook to pass to retry().

Examples

after_sleep_log(function(msg) cat(msg, "\n"))
#> <garnish::after_sleep_log>
#>  @ logger: function (msg)
